name: Vöckönd (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Vöckönd (a blue shield with a white church and a yellow bunch of grapes, between branches) below the name VÖCKÖND in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
